question_text: A government employee is accused of accepting bribes in exchange for expediting a permit. The Office of the Ombudsman receives a complaint. Which of the following best describes the mandate of the Ombudsman in this situation?

options.text: It has the power to investigate and prosecute the employee for graft and corruption.
It can only conduct a fact-finding investigation but cannot file charges.
It can impose administrative penalties such as suspension or dismissal.
It can order the arrest of the employee without a warrant.
